title: Software company soars amid plans to cut 1,000 jobs

content_html:
ServiceNow (NOW) plans to cut up to 1,000 jobs, and its stock went up on the news.

That reaction surprised many people, given that layoffs usually signal trouble. Yet NOW's stock price climbed toward $111 after the plan surfaced, up about 9% over five trading sessions.

The stock had fallen more than 24% year-to-date before the rally because investors had spent months worried that AI would eat into the software ServiceNow sells.

The job cuts, paired with a strong second-quarter report, directly pushed back against that fear.

So the question for investors holding or considering buying ServiceNow is simple. Why did cutting jobs make this stock more attractive?

Why ServiceNow cutting 1,000 jobs pushed NOW stock higher

The cuts equal about 3% of ServiceNow's global workforce, Investing.com reported after speaking with people familiar with the plan.

Investors read the move as a sign of discipline, not distress. ServiceNow is shrinking overlapping roles while its revenue continues to grow by more than 20% a year.

Wall Street appears to believe the move shows a company can lift margins without slowing its top line, which matters most to investors, given their focus on future profit growth.

The timing helped too. The cuts landed right after an earnings report that many investors had treated as a make-or-break test.

What ServiceNow's second-quarter earnings told investors

ServiceNow reported second-quarter revenue of $3.99 billion, up 24% from a year earlier, according to Investing.com. That beat the roughly $3.93 billion analysts expected.

Adjusted earnings came in at $0.90 a share, above the $0.86 forecast. The company also raised its full-year subscription revenue outlook.

More ServiceNow Coverage:

  • Bank of America spots ServiceNow's overlooked AI advantage

  • Goldman says ServiceNow is writing a totally new playbook

  • CLSA gives ServiceNow a bearish call before its earnings report

The number that drew the most attention was AI. ServiceNow's AI portfolio crossed $1 billion in annual contract value for the first time.

Annual contract value measures the yearly revenue locked into signed customer deals. Crossing $1 billion showed that customers are paying real money for ServiceNow's AI tools, not just testing them.

That single figure undercut the biggest bear argument against the stock.

How the AI fear had dragged NOW down all year

For most of 2026, investors feared that AI agents would let companies automate their own workflows and stop paying for software like ServiceNow's.

That worry hit the whole sector. Salesforce and other enterprise names fell sharply on the same logic.

content_html_zh:
ServiceNow (NOW) 计划裁员多达 1,000 人，消息传出后，其股价上涨。

这种反应让很多人感到惊讶，因为裁员通常预示着麻烦。 然而，该计划浮出水面后，NOW 股价攀升至 111 美元，五个交易日上涨约 9%。

今年以来，该股在上涨之前已经下跌了 24% 以上，因为投资者几个月来一直担心人工智能会侵蚀 ServiceNow 销售的软件。

裁员，加上强劲的第二季度报告，直接打消了这种担忧。

因此，对于持有或考虑购买 ServiceNow 的投资者来说，问题很简单。 为什么裁员会让这只股票更具吸引力？

为什么 ServiceNow 裁员 1,000 人推高 NOW 股价

Investing.com 在与知情人士交谈后报道称，此次裁员相当于 ServiceNow 全球员工总数的 3% 左右。

投资者将此举视为纪律的标志，而不是苦恼。 ServiceNow 正在缩小重叠的角色，而其收入每年继续增长 20% 以上。

华尔街似乎认为，此举表明公司可以在不降低营收的情况下提高利润率，这对投资者来说最为重要，因为他们关注未来的利润增长。

时机也有帮助。 此次削减是在财报发布后进行的，许多投资者将财报视为成败的考验。

ServiceNow 第二季度收益告诉投资者什么

据 Investing.com 称，ServiceNow 第二季度营收为 39.9 亿美元，同比增长 24%。 这超出了分析师大约 39.3 亿美元的预期。

调整后每股收益为 0.90 美元，高于预期 0.86 美元。 该公司还上调了全年订阅收入预期。

更多 ServiceNow 覆盖范围：

  • 美国银行发现 ServiceNow 被忽视的人工智能优势
  • 高盛表示 ServiceNow 正在编写一本全新的剧本
  • 里昂证券 (CLSA) 在 ServiceNow 发布财报前给予其悲观评级

最受关注的数字是人工智能。 ServiceNow 的人工智能产品组合的年度合同价值首次突破 10 亿美元。

年度合同价值衡量签订的客户交易中锁定的年度收入。 超过 10 亿美元表明客户正在为 ServiceNow 的人工智能工具支付真金白银，而不仅仅是测试它们。

这一数字削弱了对该股最大的看空论点。

对人工智能的恐惧是如何拖累这一整年的

在 2026 年的大部分时间里，投资者担心人工智能代理会让公司实现自己的工作流程自动化，并停止为 ServiceNow 等软件付费。

这种担忧影响了整个行业。 Salesforce和其他企业名称也因同样的逻辑而大幅下跌。
